# Steam Roulette

> Free web app that picks a random game from your list — spin a wheel, get a winner. Live Steam prices and discounts, shareable links, English/Russian UI. No sign-up, data stays in the browser.

## Links
- App: https://dvinerlove.github.io/steam-roulette/
- Promo page: https://dvinerlove.github.io/steam-roulette/landing.html
- Source code (MIT): https://github.com/dvinerlove/steam-roulette

## What it does
- Spins a wheel over a user-defined game list; fair RNG via crypto.getRandomValues
- Steam integration: auto-matches games, live regional prices and discounts, game covers
- Share a wheel + all settings via a short link
- Custom themes: backgrounds, sector colors, game images, sounds
- Features: game presets, hidden games, shuffle, winner removal, spin history

## Pricing
Free. No account, no ads, open source (MIT).
